message: Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction. Table: inventory_items. Threads involved: TX-4401 (reserve_stock), TX-4402 (reserve_stock). Both transactions waiting on each other's row locks. Deadlock rate: 240/min.

SQLSTATE[40001]: Serialization failure: 1213 Deadlock found. reserve_stock() acquires row locks in non-deterministic order across inventory_items and inventory_reservations tables. Flash sale traffic: 1,200 concurrent /reserve requests.
StockReservationService.reserve() deadlock retry budget exhausted after 3 attempts. POST /v1/inventory/reserve returning 500. Error rate 67%. Flash sale checkout broken.

Deadlock pattern: TX acquires inventory_items lock first THEN inventory_reservations. Concurrent TX acquires inventory_reservations first THEN inventory_items. Classic lock-order inversion. Fix: enforce consistent lock acquisition order or use SELECT FOR UPDATE with index hint.
Hotfix deployed: reserve_stock() now acquires locks in deterministic order (inventory_items first, then inventory_reservations). Deadlock rate: 0/min. Flash sale checkout recovering.
